description.zh: 模拟 Codex MCP（Model Context Protocol）完整集成流程：config.toml 配置 → McpConnectionManager 初始化 → RmcpClient 连接（Stdio 子进程 / StreamableHttp）→ initialize 握手（协议 2025-06-18）→ qualify_tools() 命名 → McpHandler 调用 → 审批检查 → 沙箱状态注入 → JSON-RPC tools/call → CallToolResult 返回。
description.en: Simulate complete Codex MCP integration: config.toml → McpConnectionManager init → RmcpClient connection (Stdio subprocess / StreamableHttp) → initialize handshake (protocol 2025-06-18) → qualify_tools() naming → McpHandler call → approval check → sandbox state injection → JSON-RPC tools/call → CallToolResult.

annotation.zh: McpServerConfig 支持两种传输：Stdio（spawn 子进程）和 StreamableHttp（HTTP POST/SSE，规范 2025-06-18）。enabled_tools 实现白名单过滤，required=true 表示启动失败时整个 codex exec 报错。
annotation.en: McpServerConfig supports two transports: Stdio (spawn subprocess) and StreamableHttp (HTTP POST/SSE, protocol 2025-06-18). enabled_tools implements whitelist filtering, required=true means failure causes codex exec to error.

annotation.zh: env_clear() 是安全设计核心：MCP 子进程不继承父进程环境，防止 API Key 等敏感变量泄露给第三方 MCP server。process_group(0) 确保 Kill 时整个进程树一起终止。
annotation.en: env_clear() is a security core: MCP subprocess doesn't inherit parent environment, preventing API keys from leaking to third-party MCP servers. process_group(0) ensures the entire process tree terminates on Kill.

annotation.zh: 协议版本固定为 2025-06-18（最新规范）。codex/sandbox-state-meta 是 Codex 专有扩展：server 声明支持后，每次工具调用的 _meta 字段会附加沙箱状态（sandbox_policy、cwd 等），实现服务端权限验证。
annotation.en: Protocol version is fixed at 2025-06-18 (latest spec). codex/sandbox-state-meta is Codex proprietary extension: when server declares support, each tool call's _meta field includes sandbox state (sandbox_policy, cwd, etc.) for server-side permission verification.

annotation.zh: qualify_tools() 保证全实例工具名唯一。64字符上限来自 OpenAI Responses API 限制。100工具阈值平衡了功能完整性和 context token 占用——超过100个工具会消耗大量 prompt 空间。
annotation.en: qualify_tools() guarantees instance-wide tool name uniqueness. 64-char limit comes from OpenAI Responses API. 100-tool threshold balances functionality and context token usage — over 100 tools would consume significant prompt space.

annotation.zh: 用户请求触发 MCP 工具调用路径
annotation.en: User request triggers MCP tool call path

annotation.zh: 模型调用 qualify_tools() 生成的工具名，ToolRouter 识别 mcp__ 前缀路由到 McpHandler
annotation.en: Model calls qualify_tools()-generated name; ToolRouter recognizes mcp__ prefix and routes to McpHandler

annotation.zh: read_only_hint=true 使 read_file 工具免审批，直接执行。沙箱状态通过 _meta 字段传给 MCP server，server 可据此验证调用方的访问范围是否合法。
annotation.en: read_only_hint=true makes read_file skip approval. Sandbox state is passed to MCP server via _meta, allowing server to verify whether the caller's access scope is legitimate.

annotation.zh: CallToolResult.is_error=false 表示工具成功执行。content 是 MCP 内容块数组，支持 text/image/resource 等类型。structured_content 字段支持 outputSchema 定义的结构化输出。
annotation.en: CallToolResult.is_error=false means tool executed successfully. content is an array of MCP content blocks supporting text/image/resource types. structured_content supports outputSchema-defined structured output.
